description: Factory floor kiosk. ISA-101 compliant. Zero interaction, zero scrolling. 1280x720. panels.title: $machine_id

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: always the true latest row per machine -- see v_ldi_machine_latest_full (migration 052), same pattern as the Live Production panel. */
SELECT CASE
  WHEN NOT has_data OR is_stale THEN 0
  WHEN state THEN 2
  ELSE 1
END AS "$machine_id"
FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full
WHERE eqp_id = ${machine_id:sqlstring}

panels.description: Live OK/IDLE/NO_DATA status for $machine_id, from v_ldi_machine_latest_full's single latest row per machine (is_stale = no reading in the last 5 minutes, treated as NO_DATA rather than trusting an old state). Repeats per the machine_id variable (whichever eqp_id values actually have rows in ldi_data), so this works unmodified in both real and mock data mode.

panels.title: ◉ Fleet Availability

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT-safe rewrite (World-Class QA, 2026-08-06): same
   DISTINCT-ON-vs-compressed-chunks fix as the "Machines Running" panel --
   see that panel's comment. */
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 0) AS value
FROM machines m
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT state FROM public.ldi_data d
  WHERE d.eqp_id = m.eqp_id AND $__timeFilter(d.time) AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY d.time DESC LIMIT 1
) l ON true

panels.description: Percent of the SELECTED registered+enabled LDI fleet (machine_id filter) currently OK (reporting AND running). Denominator is always the full selected machine registry, not just machines that happened to report -- a machine that goes completely silent now correctly drags this down instead of silently disappearing from both sides of the ratio.

panels.title: ◉ Critical Alarm Records (master-code matched)
panels.description: Note: Alarm durations and MTTR are not calculated as the source EAP system currently does not broadcast explicit alarm-clear events. Only occurrence times are logged. Duration estimation requires EAP team confirmation of clear/reset event availability. Active Alarms: count of unresolved alarms in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: ◉ Environmental Compliance

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id) FILTER (WHERE temperature BETWEEN 20 AND 24 AND humidity BETWEEN 50 AND 60) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id), 0))::NUMERIC, 0) AS value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND temperature IS NOT NULL AND humidity IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Environmental Compliance: percentage of machines within safe temperature AND humidity.

panels.title: ◉ Machines Running

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT-safe rewrite (World-Class QA, 2026-08-06): DISTINCT ON
   over the full requested time range forced a full scan+sort of every chunk
   (221K+ rows for the 30-day worst case this budget check tests), and once
   TimescaleDB's compress_after policy started compressing older chunks that
   became a real regression -- a per-device LATERAL lookup uses the
   (eqp_id, time DESC) index to jump straight to each device's latest row
   instead, the same pattern already proven in v_ldi_machine_latest_full. */
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = true) AS value
FROM machines m
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT state FROM public.ldi_data d
  WHERE d.eqp_id = m.eqp_id AND $__timeFilter(d.time) AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY d.time DESC LIMIT 1
) l ON true

panels.description: Count of machines currently OK (reporting AND running), out of the selected registered fleet. A silent machine is NOT counted, same fix as Fleet Availability.

panels.title: ◉ Pipeline Heartbeat
panels.description: Watchdog: re-queries the database every dashboard refresh cycle. If this panel stalls (the frontend refresh timer dying, the reported "requires F5" bug), it force-reloads the page automatically. See migration 065 for the TimescaleDB-side half of this fix.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: trivial constant-time heartbeat query, no table scan. */
SELECT NOW() AS time, 1 AS value

panels.title: ◈ Shift Pacing (OEE Estimate)

targets.rawSql:
/* Mocked Target vs Actual */
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id) FILTER (WHERE state = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT eqp_id), 0))::NUMERIC, 0) + 15 AS value FROM public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})

panels.description: Calculates pacing (Actual Production vs Target for the shift). Using a mocked offset for visual demonstration.
